title: Managed run, present-but-invalid MDM profile -> immediate honest holding (never false-Healthy)
notes: S4: the managed profile is schema-validated FIRST, before any materialize step. A present-but-invalid profile (reusing M2's settings/invalid-missing-required-field.yml -- missing the required `auth` field) must route IMMEDIATELY to Holding(ItConfigIncomplete), never a retry-then-silent-Healthy and never a doctor poll at all in the real flow (the CLI is never invoked past profile validation). doctor_fixture here is cross-referenced only to show what the eventual doctor verdict WOULD look like if this same broken profile were later materialized and diagnosed -- the wizard's own terminal comes from the profile-validation step, not from doctor, per this scenario.
